caption: The drawing depicts a single metal tankard with a large handle situated on the right side. The tankard has a cylindrical body that slightly flares outward at the base and narrows slightly towards the top. The body features two subtle horizontal bands or ridges running around its circumference, dividing it into three main sections. The handle is robust and curves outward, connecting at two points to the tankard’s upper section and lower middle section; there is a rounded decorative element near the lower attachment point. The metal surface of the tankard is rendered in shades of gray, with highlights and shadows indicating a reflective, shiny texture. The background is a plain, lightly colored surface, possibly mimicking the appearance of parchment or lightly stained paper, with some faint discoloration near the edges. There are no additional objects or patterns in the composition, and the focus is solely on the tankard.
title: Pewter Mug
